links.note: संगीत का हिस्सा -- ये तीनों: names गाना, बजाना, नाचना as the three parts of music, which is 30257 word for word. 30258 loses because it is about लय ka gyaan and the body as तपस्या, not the three-part make-up of music.
The covering that lends नृत्य its beauty is लय; the item keys लय, which is 30258's subject. 30257 lists music's three components but says nothing about लय.
पहले कथक मन्दिरों तक सीमित था -- the temple-bound early form, stated verbatim in 30256. 30255 covers the परंपरा's antiquity and its महाभारत/रामायण mention, not where it was confined.

Which घराना he belonged to -- लखनऊ: the lineage the कला descended through, which is 30247's 'यह कला उन्हें विरासत में मिली थी'. 30252 is about the परिश्रम the inheritance still demanded, not the name of the line.
पिता का नाम, अच्छन महाराज: identifies the man from whom the inherited कथक came, so 30247. 30253 is about his माँ as the mainstay of the struggle years -- a different parent and a different point.
Dates कथक to महाभारत and रामायण -- the antiquity claim 30255 makes verbatim. 30256 covers the temple-bound कथा-कहने form, not the scriptural dating.

The sacred गुरु-शिष्य bond is the गंडा -- the initiation through which an inherited कला still had to be earned, which is 30252's point. 30247 covers whom the कला came from, not the rite that opened the तालीम.
लखनऊ घराने के लोग originally of हरिया गाँव -- the deep-roots paragraph 30255 opens ('परंपरा बहुत पुरानी है'). 30247 covers his own identification with कथक, not the घराना's ancestral village.
शरीर, ध्यान और तपस्या का साधन is नाच -- 30258 says exactly this of नृत्य. 30257 names music's three parts without the तपस्या claim.
Second, near-duplicate घराना item: the लखनऊ line is the विरासत 30247 names. 30255 would fit only if the item asked where that घराना originally came from.
His father's calling -- नर्तक: the dancer-father through whom the कला was inherited, 30247. 30252 is the struggle-and-effort reading of that inheritance, not the father's profession.
From whom he got his नृत्य schooling -- माता, चाचा and पिता, i.e. the family line the कला came down. 30252 covers the भेंट/गंडा price of starting that तालीम, not the roster of teachers.
What he altered in कथक की प्रस्तुतियाँ: 30265 is the kept-the-परंपरा-changed-the-प्रस्तुतीकरण concept. 30256 describes the old कथा-कहने form itself, not his alterations.
लय is what matters in कथक -- 30258's 'लय का ज्ञान आवश्यक है'. 30257 loses because the options weigh लय against वेशभूषा and मंच, not against गाना and बजाना.
When his शिक्षा under his father began -- बचपन में; 30252 is the inheritance-plus-परिश्रम concept tied to that बचपन का प्रसंग. 30247 names the teachers but not the start of the training.
Who helped most through the childhood आर्थिक परेशानियाँ -- उनकी माँ, which is 30253 exactly. 30254 covers how she managed it (कर्ज, ज़री की साड़ियाँ), not who she was.
नृत्य = शरीर, ध्यान और तपस्या: the second half of 30258 verbatim. 30257 loses because the answer is not the three parts of संगीत.
The पद about one ताल for every three नर्तक comes from the बैरगिया नाला verse of हरिया गाँव, part of the घराना's old-roots passage 30255 covers. 30257 treats तबला only as 'बजाना', not this verse.
He folded both his पिता's and his चाचा's शैलियाँ into his own -- the प्रस्तुतीकरण change 30265 asks students to describe. 30247 covers that they were his teachers, not that he fused their styles.
What was kept from the पुरानी परंपरा (नृत्य के मूल तत्त्व) -- the 'कायम रखते हुए' half of 30265. 30255 is about the परंपरा's age, not about what survived his reworking.
He taught his बेटियाँ नृत्य -- the let-them-learn advocacy of 30259. 30260 loses because this is his own household acting, not the interview's question about a family that refuses.
महिलाओं के लिए शिक्षा या कोई हुनर -- the same learn-the-कला advocacy 30259 carries. 30253 mentions his माँ but nothing about girls needing a skill.
Blank is कथक in 'की परंपरा बहुत पुरानी है' -- 30255's own sentence. 30256 covers the कथा-कहने form, a later sentence of the same answer.
Blank is नृत्य: 'नृत्य के कार्यक्रमों से भी कभी-कभी पैसा आ जाता था' sits inside the passage on how the household was kept going, which is 30254. 30253 states only that the माँ was the mainstay.
Blank is लड़कियों -- girls must have शिक्षा or a हुनर, the advocacy 30259 covers. 30260 is the घर-के-विरोध question, not this.
Blank is संगीत in 'गाना, बजाना और नाचना ये तीनों ___ का हिस्सा हैं' -- 30257's sentence exactly. 30258 covers लय, not the three parts.
Blank is तबला: he beat one from छुटपन, the बजाना side of 30257, which says the नर्तक needs all three. 30258 is about लय's necessity, not about playing an instrument.

Blank is शास्त्रीय संगीत; the sentence likens his life to रागों because it was full of उतार-चढ़ाव, which is 30250's समय का चक्र. 30247 covers the opening's कथक-and-बिरजू pairing, not the ups-and-downs simile.
लोक नृत्य is सामूहिक. The lesson builds the लोक/शास्त्रीय split out of the कथावाचक who was a लोक नर्तक until the form fixed -- 30256's territory. 30255 covers only how old the परंपरा is.
What becoming each other's सहयोगी inspires -- the value drawn from the माँ-as-सहयोगी passage, 30253. 30254 covers her particular expedients, not the general lesson.
Why लड़कियों need शिक्षा or a हुनर -- to be आत्मनिर्भर; the same advocacy 30259 carries. 30260 loses because no family refusal is in play.
हुनर is what serves when the time comes -- his case for learning a कला or skill, 30259. 30252 is about his own परिश्रम behind an inherited कला, not about a skill as insurance.
पद्मविभूषण, his highest सम्मान: the recognition side of 30248's 'देश और विदेश में ख्याति'. 30247 names him as the कथक name that comes to mind but not the award.
Since when he beat the तबला -- बहुत छुटपन से; बजाना is one of the three 30257 says a नर्तक must command. 30258 is about लय's necessity, not about when he began playing.

He ties the गंडा only on seeing सच्ची लगन -- an initiation re-pegged to effort rather than भेंट, which is 30252's inheritance-needs-struggle point. 30265 covers changes to कथक's प्रस्तुतीकरण, not to the गुरु-शिष्य rite.
'भेंट मिलने पर ही गंडा बाँधूँगा' was said by his बाबूजी -- the price attached to opening the तालीम, 30252. 30253 enters only because the माँ then paid it; the item asks who set the condition.
989 कथिकों के घर in हरिया गाँव -- the antiquity-and-roots passage 30255 covers. 30247 is his own bond with कथक, not the village census.
From whom the कला came to him -- his पूर्वज; 30247 states exactly that विरासत. 30252 adds that the inheritance needed संघर्ष, which this item does not ask.

How his माताजी became the mainstay -- कर्ज and burning पुरानी ज़री की साड़ियाँ for their सोने-चाँदी के तार: 30254's mechanism. 30253 covers the bare fact that she was the सबसे बड़ी सहयोगी; this item asks how.
Alongside नृत्य he also बजाते and गाते -- the three-in-one competence 30257 requires of a नर्तक. 30258 covers लय, not the combination of गाना, बजाना and नाचना.
The महत्त्व of लय in नृत्य -- शरीर, ध्यान, तपस्या and संतुलन, all of 30258. 30257 lists music's three parts without the लय argument.
Why he recommends children play with लय -- his विनती that an interested बच्चा be allowed to learn, 30259. 30260 is the question about a household that objects, not the recommendation.
His full name, बृजमोहन मिश्र -- identifies the कथक name of 30247. 30248 covers the reach of his ख्याति, not his name.
What was given to his पिताजी as भेंट to open the तालीम -- the गंडा-and-भेंट transaction, 30252. 30253 is about the माँ as mainstay of the money troubles, a wider point than this rite.
सितार, गिटार, सरोद, तबला -- instruments learned, the बजाना of 30257. 30258 is about लय's necessity rather than instrument-playing.
The तालीम-opening custom: गुरु ties the गंडा, शिष्य gives भेंट -- 30252's point that even an inherited कला had to be earned. 30247 names the teachers but not the rite.
The old रूप of कथक -- a रोचक, अनौपचारिक way of कथा कहना; 30256 verbatim. 30255 covers its antiquity and scriptural mention, not the form.
Why he built कथक रचनाएँ from poets of many languages -- one of the changes made while keeping the परंपरा, 30265. 30255 covers the परंपरा's age, not his additions.
The चाचा's warning that a नौकरी would split the नर्तक in him -- the passage where he resolves that 'महाराज' takes मेहनत, 30252. 30251 is the childhood-struggles prompt, not this working-life choice.
His तालीम came from पिता अच्छन महाराज and चाचा शंभू and लच्छू -- the family line of 30247. 30252 covers the भेंट that opened that तालीम, not who taught him.
Describe his बचपन के संघर्ष -- 30251 is the interviewer's 'बचपन संघर्षों से भरा था' prompt itself. 30254 covers only the माँ's expedients inside that account; the item asks for the account.
